The '''Security Division''', also known as ''' Corporate Security''', was the military arm of the [[Corporate Sector Authority/Legends|Corporate Sector Authority]], created within the framework laid down by the [[Corporate Sector Charter]]. The Security Division was responsible for all peacekeeping activities within the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]], and their personnel was drawn from corporate investigators, [[planetary ranger]]s, [[Skip tracer/Legends|skip tracers]], civilian defense advisors, and retired [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]] personnel. Subdivisions within the Security Division included [[Locational Enforcement/Legends|Locational Enforcement]], which was responsible for the physical security of facilities within the Corporate Sector; [[Situational Enforcement/Legends|Situational Enforcement]], which analyzed crime patterns throughout the Corporate Sector; [[Ground Forces/Legends|Ground Forces]], which provided law enforcement throughout the Sector; the [[Picket Fleet/Legends|Picket Fleet]], the naval arm of the Security Division; and the [[Detention Taskforce]], charged with providing correctional facilities for the Sector's criminals.<ref name="HSCS" />

The Security Division maintained a [[Picket Fleet/Legends|large fleet]] but of relatively outdated vessels to patrol their territory. Most of the fleet consisted of first-generation [[Victory I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory-I''-class Star Destroyers]], [[Invincible-class Dreadnaught Heavy Cruiser|''Invincible''-class Dreadnaughts]],<ref name="HSCS" /> secondhand [[Recusant-class light destroyer/Legends|''Recusant''-class light destroyers]]<ref name="SOTG07">[[Starships of the Galaxy (Saga Edition)|''Starships of the Galaxy'', Saga Edition]]</ref> and [[Marauder-class Assault Corvette/Legends|''Marauder''-class corvettes]]. The [[IRD starfighter|Authority IRD]] was one of the numerous types of starfighters used by the Security Division,<ref name="HSCS">''[[Han Solo and the Corporate Sector Sourcebook]]''</ref> as was the former CIS [[Mankvim-814 light interceptor/Legends|Mankvim-814 light interceptor]].<ref name="SOTG07" />
